dz: 巴赫为主显节创作的康塔塔《他们都将从示巴而来》（Sie werden aus Saba alle kommen，BWV 65）首次演出。
de: Sie werden aus Saba alle kommen, BWV 65, a Bach cantata, for Epiphany, is performed the first time.

t: 俄罗斯科学院由彼得大帝在俄罗斯圣彼得堡创建,由参议院法令实施. 它被称作"圣彼得堡科学院",直…
te: The Russian Academy of Sciences is founded in St. Petersburg, Russia, by Peter the Great, and implemented by Senate dec…
dz: 俄罗斯科学院由彼得大帝在俄罗斯圣彼得堡创建,由参议院法令实施. 它被称作"圣彼得堡科学院",直到1917年.
de: The Russian Academy of Sciences is founded in St. Petersburg, Russia, by Peter the Great, and implemented by Senate decree. It is called the St. Petersburg Academy of Sciences until 1917.

t: 在莱比锡的圣尼古拉教堂(St. Nicholas Church, Leipzig)出演了Bac…
te: Premiere performance of Bach's St John Passion, BWV 245, at St. Nicholas Church, Leipzig.
dz: 在莱比锡的圣尼古拉教堂(St. Nicholas Church, Leipzig)出演了Bach's St John Passion, BWV 245等电影.
de: Premiere performance of Bach's St John Passion, BWV 245, at St. Nicholas Church, Leipzig.

t: 巴赫领导他"Cantata Erfreut euch","ihr Herzen","BWV 6…

dz: 巴赫领导他"Cantata Erfreut euch","ihr Herzen","BWV 66","他为莱比锡复活节所编的第一部Cantata"的首次演出.
de: Bach leads the first performance of his cantata Erfreut euch, ihr Herzen, BWV 66, his first cantata composed for Easter in Leipzig.

t: 约翰·塞巴斯蒂安 巴赫领衔主演了自己的"Cantata Du Hirte Israel","h…
te: Johann Sebastian Bach leads the first performance of his cantata Du Hirte Israel, höre, BWV 104, illustrating the topic…
dz: 约翰·塞巴斯蒂安 巴赫领衔主演了自己的"Cantata Du Hirte Israel","höre","BWV 104"等首场演出,在牧歌中展现出"好牧人"的主题.
de: Johann Sebastian Bach leads the first performance of his cantata Du Hirte Israel, höre, BWV 104, illustrating the topic of the Good Shepherd in pastoral music.

t: 约翰·塞巴斯蒂安·巴赫带领他的Cantata O Ewigkeit, du Donnerwor…
te: Johann Sebastian Bach leads his cantata O Ewigkeit, du Donnerwort (O eternity, you word of thunder), BWV 20, on the fir…
dz: 约翰·塞巴斯蒂安·巴赫带领他的Cantata O Ewigkeit, du Donnerwort (O Enever,你所说的"雷"),BWV 20,在"三一"后的第一个星期天,开始他的第二个周期,Chorale Cantata周期.
de: Johann Sebastian Bach leads his cantata O Ewigkeit, du Donnerwort (O eternity, you word of thunder), BWV 20, on the first Sunday after Trinity, beginning his second cycle, the chorale cantata cycle.

t: 在施洗者圣约翰节，巴赫指挥首演了《我们的主基督来到约旦河》（Christ unser Herr…
te: On the Feast of St. John the Baptist, Bach leads the first performance of his Christ unser Herr zum Jordan kam, BWV 7, …
dz: 在施洗者圣约翰节，巴赫指挥首演了《我们的主基督来到约旦河》（Christ unser Herr zum Jordan kam，BWV 7），这是他众赞歌康塔塔系列中的第三部康塔塔。
de: On the Feast of St. John the Baptist, Bach leads the first performance of his Christ unser Herr zum Jordan kam, BWV 7, the third cantata of his chorale cantata cycle.

t: 约翰·塞巴斯蒂安 巴赫领衔主演了尼姆·冯·恩斯(英语:Nimm von uns, Mr, du…
te: Johann Sebastian Bach leads the first performance of Nimm von uns, Herr, du treuer Gott, BWV 101, a chorale cantata on …
dz: 约翰·塞巴斯蒂安 巴赫领衔主演了尼姆·冯·恩斯(英语:Nimm von uns, Mr, du treuer Gott, BWV 101)一出出出自出名曲"花花相声"的花相声.
de: Johann Sebastian Bach leads the first performance of Nimm von uns, Herr, du treuer Gott, BWV 101, a chorale cantata on a famous tune.

t: 约翰·塞巴斯蒂安 巴赫领跑杰苏,德·德·米内·塞勒(德语:der du meine Seele…
te: Johann Sebastian Bach leads the first performance of Jesu, der du meine Seele, BWV 78, a chorale cantata based on a pas…
dz: 约翰·塞巴斯蒂安 巴赫领跑杰苏,德·德·米内·塞勒(德语:der du meine Seele, BWV 78)一出由约翰·里斯特(英语:Johann Rist)出演的以激情赞美为主的克罗莱·坎塔塔.
de: Johann Sebastian Bach leads the first performance of Jesu, der du meine Seele, BWV 78, a chorale cantata based on a passion hymn by Johann Rist.

t: J·S·巴赫(J. S. Bach)以保罗·艾伯(Paul Eber)的赞美诗为主演"高特先生…
te: J. S. Bach leads the first performance of Herr Gott, dich loben alle wir, BWV 130 for the feast of archangel Michael, b…
dz: J·S·巴赫(J. S. Bach)以保罗·艾伯(Paul Eber)的赞美诗为主演"高特先生"(Herr Gott, dich loben alle wir, BWV 130)出演了"大天使迈克尔"(Archanger Michael)的宴会"出演"十二相".
de: J. S. Bach leads the first performance of Herr Gott, dich loben alle wir, BWV 130 for the feast of archangel Michael, based on Paul Eber's hymn in twelve stanzas.

t: J. S. Bach在"三一"后的第20个星期天在莱比锡领衔主演了斯克姆克·迪克(英语:Sch…
te: J. S. Bach leads the first performance of Schmücke dich, o liebe Seele (Adorn yourself, O dear soul) in Leipzig on the …
dz: J. S. Bach在"三一"后的第20个星期天在莱比锡领衔主演了斯克姆克·迪克(英语:Schmücke dich, o liebe Seele (Adorn yourself, O dear soul))的首场演出,以同名同名的圣餐颂歌为基础.
de: J. S. Bach leads the first performance of Schmücke dich, o liebe Seele (Adorn yourself, O dear soul) in Leipzig on the 20th Sunday after Trinity, based on the communion hymn of the same name.

t: 约瑟夫·布莱克(Joseph Blake),别名布鲁斯金(Blueskin),是一名以攻击"T…
te: Joseph Blake, alias Blueskin, a highwayman known for attacking "Thief-Taker General" (and thief) Jonathan Wild at the O…
dz: 约瑟夫·布莱克(Joseph Blake),别名布鲁斯金(Blueskin),是一名以攻击"Thief-Taker General"(和小偷)"老贝利"(Jonathan Wild at the Old Bailey)而出名的高速公路人,被绞死在伦敦.
de: Joseph Blake, alias Blueskin, a highwayman known for attacking "Thief-Taker General" (and thief) Jonathan Wild at the Old Bailey, is hanged in London.

t: 宗教骚乱之后，波兰当局处决了九名新教公民和索恩（托伦）市长。
te: Religious unrest is followed by the execution of nine Protestant citizens and the mayor of Thorn (Toruń) by Polish auth…
dz: 索恩骚乱：宗教骚乱之后，波兰当局处决了九名新教公民和索恩（托伦）市长。
de: Tumult of Thorn: Religious unrest is followed by the execution of nine Protestant citizens and the mayor of Thorn (Toruń) by Polish authorities.

t: J. S. Bach以路德1524年圣诞颂歌为基础,在莱比锡领衔主演了"克苏基督"(Gelob…

dz: J. S. Bach以路德1524年圣诞颂歌为基础,在莱比锡领衔主演了"克苏基督"(Gelobet seist du, Jesu Christ, BWV 91)的首次演出.
de: J. S. Bach leads the first performance of Gelobet seist du, Jesu Christ, BWV 91, in Leipzig, based on Luther's 1524 Christmas hymn.
